## FAQ

*What is the recommended attire for the Summit?*

> There is no dress code for the Summit. Perhaps visiting Houston is your chance to break out shorts, or perhaps now is the time for you to channel your inner [Wonder Kid](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/ted-lasso-nick-mohammed-nate-shelley-6447f31b9d4a7.jpg){target=_blank}. **To cultivate a more sociable atmosphere on the first day of the Summit, Friday is jersey day! Participants are encouraged (but not required) to wear their favorite soccer jerseys on Friday.**
